hypotheses.multiplicity: Holm across H1, H2, H3 (family of three), alpha 0.05

H1.claim: No single classical scheme is the cheapest qualifying scheme in all four headline cells.
H1.procedure: Hierarchical bootstrap, 10,000 replicates: resample CAL, SEL and EVAL seeds with replacement; in every replicate recompute q*, m* (CAL), each scheme family's SEL selection, and its EVAL qualification and cost; record whether one family is the cheapest qualifying family in all 4 cells.
H1.statistic: share of replicates in which one family wins all four
H1.decision: supported if the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound of that share is < 0.05
H1.p_value: exact one-sided binomial test of the share against 0.05

H2.claim: Policy (SEL-selected bias) vs adaptive classical (SEL-selected), both deployable, scored on EVAL.
H2.primary_statistic: pooled mean over headline cells where both qualify of (mean policy cost / mean adaptive cost - 1); per-cell values also reported
H2.uncertainty: hierarchical bootstrap over training seeds x EVAL seeds (selections recomputed per replicate), 10,000 replicates, percentile 95% CI
also: P(policy cost < adaptive cost) from the bootstrap
qualification-rate difference with a Newcombe (Wilson) 95% interval
H2.decision: two-sided; superiority claimed only if the 95% CI upper bound < 0; equivalence declared only by TOST with margin +/-5% (both one-sided tests at alpha 0.05); a non-significant result is never called 'no difference'
H2.p_value: bootstrap two-sided p = 2 x min(P*(stat <= 0), P*(stat >= 0))

H3.claim: The custom simulator agrees with Veins on the pre-specified metrics (SUMO mobility, identical traces and seeds, 4 headline cells, 10 seeds per cell).
criteria_all_required: Spearman rank correlation of classical-scheme matched costs across cells and schemes >= 0.8 with lower 95% bootstrap bound >= 0.6
per-hop PDR-vs-distance within 0.05 absolute in every 50 m bin up to the nominal range
median single-hop delivery delay within one decision epoch (100 ms)
H1 verdict identical in both simulators
H3.p_value: bootstrap p for Spearman rho <= 0.6 (the Holm-tested component); the other criteria are pass/fail
H3.decision_rule: pass -> validated for these metrics in these cells; fail -> add a sub-epoch timing mode (13 us slots, AIFS/backoff; default unchanged), calibrate only on the validation metrics, freeze, re-run; still failing -> classical audit results computed in Veins become primary and custom-simulator claims are restricted

RAR.rule: p = clip(a*rho_c + b*(1 - n/n_max) + c, 0, 1), n_max = 30, slotted deferral by distance (5 slots); inputs = causal relevance, neighbour count, distance to sender, message age (age gates rebroadcast after the message TTL as for every policy)
RAR.note: grid cut from ~60 to 27 settings (user decision, pre-registered)

SCF_slotted.rule: slotted 1-persistence + carry the message and rebroadcast on a new neighbour until the carry timeout
